subject: Geopolitics
title: Crimea and Annexation
description: A fast breakdown of Crimea and Annexation for builders.

hook.text: In 2014 soldiers without insignia appeared in Crimea. Within weeks, Russia annexed a territory of 2 million.

buildup.text: Crimea was transferred from Russia to Ukraine in 1954. When Ukraine tilted West, Russia took it back by force.

discovery.text: The annexation broke the post-1945 taboo: borders in Europe are not changed by force. Russia broke it.

twist.text: A hasty referendum with 97% approval gave the annexation a democratic veneer. Few nations recognized it.

climax.text: Crimea set a precedent. If one power can annex territory, others will try. The rules eroded globally.

punchline.text: Borders hold until someone strong enough ignores them.

quiz.question: What post-1945 norm did Russia's annexation of Crimea break?
options: Borders in Europe are not changed by force
Freedom of navigation in international waters
